name: Caro-Kann Defense
description: A solid Black repertoire against e4 that prepares d5 with support and teaches calm structure-based defense.

branches.title: Main Line: c6 and d5

moves.title: White claims center
moves.explanation: White takes space and opens lines. e4 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Caro-Kann is about structure: Black develops the light bishop, then challenges White center safely.

moves.title: Prepare d5
moves.explanation: c6 supports the d5 break. Black is planning before challenging. c6 changes the central structure. Central pawn moves should either claim space, challenge an enemy pawn, or open a line for a piece. The Caro-Kann is about structure: Black develops the light bishop, then challenges White center safely.

moves.title: White builds center

moves.title: Challenge with support

The Caro-Kann is about structure: Black develops the light bishop, then challenges White center safely.

commonMistakes: Trapping the light-squared bishop too early.
